notes: Owner-maintained; Claude only reads it. The router sends each step to the best enabled model that may do the order's risk tier, fits the request within the model's tokens-per-minute limit, and still has quota today. Gemini values were copied from Google AI Studio's rate-limit page (project 'My First Project', free tier) on 2026-10-09. Mistral values were copied from Admin > Limits (Region Global) on 2026-10-10; Mistral sets limits per model (requests per second, shown here as rpm = rps x 60, rounded down) and shows no daily or monthly cap. Never add a model whose tpm_input is below about 60,000: one work-order request is 20,000 to 40,000 input tokens (mistral-medium-latest, mistral-large-4 and mistral-small-2603 allow only 20,000). Model keys are API model names: run the relay with --models to confirm them.

gemini.data_use: Free tier: Google may use prompts and responses to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them.

mistral.data_use: Free (Experiment) plan: may be used for training unless 'Anonymous improvement data' is switched off in Admin > Privacy.

nvidia.data_use: API trial terms: for testing and evaluation, not production; NVIDIA may use content to improve its products and models.

openrouter.data_use: Free models: some upstream hosts log prompts or train on them.
